hero.title: Run your business with
hero.description: Manage branches, employees, products, sales, payments, inventory, money and reports from one connected platform.

productOverview.title: Everything important, connected.
productOverview.description: Offlix Manager brings the operational parts of your business into one place so your team can work from the same information.
productOverview.branchesDescription: Keep multiple locations organized from a single workspace.
productOverview.employeesDescription: Give people the access they need without giving everyone everything.
productOverview.inventoryDescription: Know what you have, where it is, and what needs attention.
productOverview.moneyDescription: Track business money alongside the activity that creates it.

organization.title: Keep every branch under control.
organization.description: Create branches, organize employees, and control what each person can see or change.
organization.feature1Description: Manage locations from the same organization.
organization.feature2Description: Assign people to branches and roles.
organization.feature3Description: Keep sensitive actions limited to the right people.

inventory.title: Know what is moving through your business.
inventory.description: Organize products, categories and stock so sales and inventory stay connected instead of living in separate systems.

sales.title: Turn every sale into useful business information.
sales.description: Sales are connected to products, inventory, payments and money, giving your team one consistent flow from checkout to reporting.
sales.fastSalesDescription: Create sales with product information and current prices already available.
sales.stockUpdatesDescription: Completed sales can update inventory so stock reflects actual business activity.
sales.moneyFlowDescription: Connect completed sales with the money your business receives.

paymentVerification.title: Verify payments from the information you already receive.
paymentVerification.description: Give your team practical ways to verify a payment, whether it starts with a QR code, a screenshot, a receipt, or a supported payment message.

paymentCapabilities.scanQrDescription: Use the device camera to inspect supported payment QR information.
paymentCapabilities.uploadScreenshotsDescription: Upload a screenshot of a QR code or payment confirmation when scanning is not convenient.
paymentCapabilities.checkReceiptsDescription: Review receipt screenshots and payment confirmation details.
paymentCapabilities.readMessagesDescription: Review supported SMS or payment messages to help verify the transaction.

moneyManagement.title: Keep business money organized with the rest of the operation.
moneyManagement.description: Track accounts, income, expenses and transfers without losing the connection to your sales and daily business activity.

reports.title: See the business, not just the transactions.
reports.description: Bring operational information together so owners and managers can understand what is happening across their business.

capabilities.title: Useful capabilities beyond the dashboard.
capabilities.description: Offlix Manager is designed around how teams actually work, including mobile use, connectivity limitations and different languages.
capabilities.offlineDescription: Keep working from mobile applications when connectivity is unavailable, then synchronize supported activity when the connection returns.
capabilities.multilingualDescription: Make the product accessible to teams that work in different languages instead of forcing everyone into one language.
capabilities.accessDescription: Use roles and permissions to give employees the right level of access for their responsibilities.

mobile.title: Your team should not stop working because the connection does.
mobile.description: Offline-capable mobile applications let teams keep working in places where internet access is unreliable. Supported activity can be synchronized when connectivity returns.

languages.title: Let the product speak to the people using it.
languages.description: Multilingual functionality makes it possible to build a workspace that fits the language needs of different teams and markets.
languages.cardDescription: Choose the language your team needs.

connectedWorkflow.title: One action can keep the rest of the system in sync.
connectedWorkflow.description: The value is not just having more screens. It is having the important parts of your operation connected.

dailyUse.title: From opening the branch to closing the day.
dailyUse.description: Offlix Manager brings the recurring work of your business into a consistent workflow.
dailyUse.openDescription: Check branch activity, employees and what needs attention.
dailyUse.sellDescription: Create sales, verify payments and keep stock moving.
dailyUse.trackDescription: Record income, expenses and other money movements.
dailyUse.reviewDescription: Use reports and business information to make decisions.

finalCta.title: Build a clearer way to run your business.
finalCta.description: Bring your branches, people, products, sales, payments, money and reports into one connected workspace.

mockups.uploadReceiptDesc: Upload a screenshot or receipt message.
mockups.readPaymentMessageDesc: Review supported SMS or payment messages.
mockups.saleCompletedDesc: The sale can now be completed.

footer.description: Business management made simple. The all-in-one manager for modern teams.
